kept.excerpt: “No date or venue” has yet been finalized for the resumption of long-stalled direct talks between the US and Iran aimed at ending their months-long war, Pakistani government sources told Anadolu on Monday. Pakistani and Qatari mediators are in contact with Washington and Tehran to finalize a date and venue for the resumption of direct talks, the sources said.
kept.relevance: Documents active mediation efforts alongside the absence of a confirmed meeting date or venue earlier in August.

kept.excerpt: Tehran, IRNA -- Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi says negotiations between Iran and the United States are currently not taking place, stressing that talks cannot resume until Washington ends its violation of commitments and compensates for those breaches. Speaking to reporters on the sidelines of an event titled “Muharram and Ashura in Reflection of Foreign Ministry Documents” in Tehran on Sunday, Araghchi said messages were being exchanged between Iran and the US through intermediaries, but that the process should not be called negotiations.
kept.relevance: Records Iran’s stated prerequisites for resuming negotiations and its distinction between intermediary messages and actual talks.

kept.excerpt: Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araqchi said Tehran has not decided whether to resume negotiations with the United States, stressing that messages exchanged through Qatar and Pakistan do not constitute talks. He described separate talks with Oman over the Strait of Hormuz as “entirely technical and specialized,” focused on establishing new shipping lanes.
kept.publisher: Radio Free Europe/Radio Liberty, republished by GlobalSecurity.org
kept.relevance: Provides a near-cutoff Iranian status statement and helps distinguish Oman shipping discussions from a qualifying US-Iran diplomatic round.

kept.excerpt: Kushner tells Fox News that Trump is currently focused on maintaining economic pressure against Iran, through the US blockade of Iranian ports and other means.
kept.relevance: Provides contemporaneous evidence of the US negotiating team’s emphasis on economic pressure while its public comments also described continuing contacts.

kept.excerpt: U.S. President Donald Trump said on Tuesday no talks were taking place with Iran and insisted the Strait of Hormuz was open, contradicting Iran's assertion that the critical waterway remained shut to shipping. “There are no talks or conversations going on, or scheduled, with the Islamic Republic of Iran,” Trump said in a post on Truth Social. Iran remains open to dialogue with the U.S. but does not confuse negotiations with surrender, Mohammad Mokhber, an adviser to Iran’s supreme leader, said on Tuesday, according to the semi-official Fars news agency.
kept.relevance: Supplies cutoff-day statements that no talks were ongoing or scheduled while preserving Iran’s conditional openness to dialogue.

kept.excerpt: The Strait of Hormuz will remain shut until the U.S. meets the conditions of an interim deal signed with Iran in June, the top Iranian negotiator Mohammad Baqer Qalibaf said in comments published by state media on Tuesday. These conditions include the U.S. lifting its blockade of Iranian ports, lifting oil sanctions, releasing Tehran’s frozen assets, and ending threats and military operations on all fronts, Qalibaf told parliament.
kept.relevance: Identifies concrete unresolved commitments cited by Iran’s senior negotiator that bear on the prospects for another formal diplomatic round.

removed.reason: The June 22 excerpt describes a roadmap aimed at a final agreement within 60 days, implying a time horizon extending beyond the August 18 cutoff (to approximately August 21). Removed under the rule excluding excerpt/relevance content that mentions or implies anything after the cutoff.

search_notes: Frozen evidence pack for Q055 with publication cutoff 2026-08-18 inclusive. All included items have explicit publication dates on or before the cutoff in indexed source text; the latest Reuters republication was published and modified on August 18. No prediction-market pages, odds, market prices, later developments, or outcome evidence are included. web_fetch failed because multiple fetch providers were registered without a selected provider; the requested agent-reach web-read fallback was rate-limited, so verification relied on web_search results exposing dated source text. Full-page retrieval and archival capture were therefore not completed. Intermediary messages and Oman-only shipping talks are not treated as proof that an authorized senior-level in-person US-Iran round began. The supplied resolution text ends mid-sentence, so no missing eligibility provisions have been inferred.
